title: galeopsis ladanum subsp. intermedia
intro: Galeopsis ladanum subsp. intermedia, commonly known as the intermediate hedge nettle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Galeopsis ladanum subsp. intermedia include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting antiviral properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
